candidate_order_hint: Models are tried from top to bottom. Leave a model blank to use its provider’s default.
candidate_duplicate: Each provider and model pair can appear only once.
candidate_choose_provider: Choose an available provider for each model.
candidate_no_providers: No directly callable provider is available for this purpose.
candidate_no_requests: The extension has not requested a model list yet.
unsupported: This hub is too old to configure models here. Update the hub first.
intro: Each feature uses these settings the next time it runs; tasks already working aren't interrupted. Manage connections and credentials in Model providers.
schedule_default: Scheduled tasks use the main chat's model configuration by default.
execution_headless: Answers through a background process on the selected computer, without a terminal panel. Runs in the assistant's working directory using the launcher's environment and Claude/Codex configuration directory, which the launcher may override. Choose a launcher available on that computer or a Messages provider. Used for the main chat and scheduled tasks.
execution_engine: Opens an interactive agent in the target computer's terminal host. Uses that computer's selected host (such as herdr or Orca), terminal environment and launcher configuration directory. The host is a computer setting, not a provider setting. Choose an available launcher or a Messages provider. Used for new agents.
lark_headless_inheritance: Inherits the Agents model · Runs as a background process
execution_api: The assistant sends HTTP requests directly, without a local agent process, terminal environment or Claude/Codex configuration directory. Connections and credentials come from Model providers. Supports Messages, Responses and Chat. Used for information processing, screening, answering agents' questions and extensions' model calls. Pick a Claude Code launcher instead and each request runs its CLI once, headless, with no tools, on the main chat's computer, using the login there.
execution_plugin: The extension's own model service handles requests using its environment, configuration and credentials, without starting a Persona agent process. Only models offered by the extension are available. Typically used for voice services.
execution_unverified: Unverified means this launcher hasn't been confirmed to run on the target computer. It doesn't mean a model call succeeded or failed.
no_purposes: The hub has no model uses to configure yet
claude_code_only: Runs on Claude Code only: pick a Claude Code launcher or a Messages API connection.
saved: Saved; applies from the next run
conflict: The configuration was changed elsewhere. Your edits are kept; reload, then edit and save again.
effective_footer: A use's settings take priority over the defaults; a one-off choice in a session or task can still override them.
picker_hint_provider: Default uses this provider's default model. The list matches what /model shows in a terminal; type an ID for one that isn't listed.
picker_hint_inherit: Default leaves it unset, so it follows the level above. The list matches what /model shows in a terminal; type an ID for one that isn't listed.
picker_hint_provider_machine: Default uses this provider's default model. The list matches what /model shows in a terminal (from {machine}); type an ID for one that isn't listed.
picker_hint_inherit_machine: Default leaves it unset, so it follows the level above. The list matches what /model shows in a terminal (from {machine}); type an ID for one that isn't listed.
field_hint: Leave empty to follow the level above. A model ID you type isn't tested, so it may not work.
permission_mode_hint: Leave on default to inherit from the category above or use the launcher's own default. Applies to new starts only.
permission_mode_hint_inbox: Without a choice here, Inbox chats use Default permissions and never inherit Agents' Full access. Plan is unavailable because it blocks required Persona tools. Applies to new chats and stopped chats when they resume; running chats keep their mode.
api_model_hint: Choose a discovered model or enter any model ID. Your edits are not saved until you choose Save.
api_effort_hint: These reasoning options are reported for this model. A current value not in the list is kept.
api_effort_unknown: The connection did not report reasoning levels. These are the standard protocol options.
api_effort_unavailable: The reported reasoning levels cannot be saved for this purpose. Use the default or choose another model.
api_effort_unsupported: This provider or model does not support choosing a reasoning effort.
api_test_hint: Sends a small request using these edits. It may cost a little; nothing is saved.
api_provider_unsupported: This connection cannot be checked here. Choose a saved provider from Model providers.
api_test_auth: Authentication failed. Check this provider’s key and access permissions in Model providers.
api_test_model: The model was not found. Choose a listed model or check the model ID.
api_test_timeout: The connection test timed out. Check the provider connection and try again.
api_test_other: Connection failed. Check the provider settings and the error details.
api_test_inheritance: Choose explicit values to test these edits. This hub cannot preview a change to inherited settings.
api_test_effort: This hub cannot verify the selected reasoning effort. Update the hub, then test again.
save_note: Saving only changes the configuration. It doesn't send a model request or interrupt running tasks.
main_other_kind: The current main chat runs on {actual}. {configured} applies to a new main chat, not this one.
save_note_plugin: Saving only changes the configuration. It doesn't send a model request or interrupt running tasks. The voice model is Persona's default choice and doesn't change the extension's own provider or credentials.
runtime_hint: The Agent SDK needs Node 22+ on that computer; without it the CLI is used
config_dir_hint: “This computer's” starts new chats with the sign-in and settings claude uses there, a gateway in ~/.claude included. Chats already started keep theirs.
supervise_description: Follows up and reviews the tasks Persona hands out, so the main chat stays free to answer you. It can run on a cheaper or a stronger model than the main chat.
usage_detail: Last 7 days (UTC): {input} input, {output} output, {cache_write} cache write and {cache_read} cache read tokens; failed calls: {failures}. The tokens shown are input + output + cache writes; cache reads are left out.
